description: PlatinAI 4-cell combined regression R² across Wf-77 ASTSR baseline, Wf-77 Hilbert baseline, Wf-79 3-way PLL, Wf-122 P3 post-fix Hilbert+ASTSR combined anchor, and Wf-128 P3 3-way (Deflexpressor + Multi-PH + ASTSR) cross-dataset verify. Central aggregator for PlatinAI 4-cell R² reporting.
source: molmetal/scripts/bench_hilbert_astr_combined_real.py + Wf-77/79 + Wf-122 P3 post-fix + Wf-128 P3 3-way

wf125_p3_172d_multitask/platinai_4cell.feature_stack: 12-d RDKit + 32-d Multi-PH Fourier (16 cos + 16 sin on bond-angle / dihedral histogram) + 128-d PLL persistence image (Vietoris-Rips filtration, Gaussian kernel σ=0.1)
wf125_p3_172d_multitask/platinai_4cell.backbone: shared 2-layer MLP trunk (172 → 256 → 128, ReLU + Dropout 0.2) + 4 per-cell-line regression heads (128 → 64 → 1, ReLU + Dropout 0.2)
wf125_p3_172d_multitask/platinai_4cell.guards: Hilbert L2 proximal shrinkage (l2_weight=0.01) + ASTSR scale-mismatch band [-10, 10] + W₂ pIC50 distribution regulariser (wasserstein_weight=0.05) + L2 grad-norm guard (max_norm=5.0)
wf125_p3_172d_multitask/platinai_4cell.feature_cache_status: NOT YET WRITTEN (4078-SMILES build DEFERRED; killed at SMILES 200/4078 due to session time budget; ~30 min cache + ~30 min bench = ~80 min total on RTX 5090)
wf125_p3_172d_multitask/platinai_4cell.verdict: CODE_SHIP_BENCH_DEFERRED — strongest honesty-tier lever; full bench DEFERRED on cache-build timeout; architectural signal floor remains; Wf-129 P3 sibling shows regularisers PREVENT divergence but do NOT lift floor (R² = -0.0780 still below +0.30 gate)
wf125_p3_172d_multitask/platinai_4cell.honest_framing_note: The 172-d + multi-task + Wasserstein stack is the STRONGEST honesty-tier lever we have for breaking the 12-d RDKit signal floor. The Wf-129 P3 Multi-PH + PLL end-to-end guarded sibling MEASURED R² = -0.0780 (per-cell-line: MCF7 -0.0582 / A549 -0.0702 / A2780 -0.0967 / A2780cis -0.0868) — +5.58 R² delta vs Wf-122 P3 post-fix (-5.66); the regularisers PREVENT divergence but do NOT lift the architectural signal floor. If the Wf-125 P3 bench also returns R² < 0 for all 4 cell lines after the cache builds, the L4/L5/L7/L8/L11 central Lambda claim needs a different feature regime (e.g., reaction-product features from the 5-click productive space).

wf128_p3_3way/platinai_4cell.feature_stack: 12-d RDKit + 32-d Multi-PH zeros + 128-d PLL zeros (no PlatinAI 172-d NPZ ships)
wf128_p3_3way/platinai_4cell.backbone: 3-way closed-form ridge (Hilbert + Multi-PH + ASTSR streams) — multi-task backbone skipped for PlatinAI 4-cell
wf128_p3_3way/platinai_4cell.guards: ASTSR predictions clipped to [0, 1] (Wf-127 P1 stable-region cap)

wf129_p3_multiph_pll_guarded/platinai_4c.guards: Hilbert L2 proximal shrinkage (l2_weight=0.01) + ASTSR scale-mismatch band [0.05, 20.0] + W₂ pIC50 distribution regulariser (wasserstein_weight=0.05)
wf129_p3_multiph_pll_guarded/platinai_4c.target_delta_vs_wf122_p3_post_fix_mean: +5.5846 (LESS NEGATIVE; Wf-129 P3 -0.0780 BETTER than Wf-122 P3 post-fix -5.6625 on PlatinAI 4-cell)
wf129_p3_multiph_pll_guarded/platinai_4c.verdict: HONEST-NEGATIVE — R² = -0.0780 vs target +0.30 (Δ -0.378). Code + tests + per-cohort metrics SHIP; lift NOT achieved. The Hilbert L2 + ASTSR scale + W₂ pIC50 regularisers PREVENT divergence (no fold produced r2 = -inf; no ASTSR collapse fires; all l2_penalty_last finite) but do not lift the 12-d RDKit signal floor (Wf-49 §Cause 2). The +5.58 R² improvement vs Wf-122 P3 post-fix (-5.66) is consistent with the Hilbert-L2 proximal shrinkage + W₂ pIC50 distribution regulariser stabilising the per-fold predictions on the no-collapse synthetic — but the architectural signal floor remains. Real lift requires Wf-94 R20-P3 Multi-PH + PLL real feature augmentation (32-bin Fourier + 128-d PLL signature, NOT zero-padded).

pre_fix_comparison.description: Wf-85 P3 pre-fix anchor (collapse-tricked) preserved for direct comparison
pre_fix_comparison.interpretation: Post-fix -5.66 is WORSE than pre-fix -1.50 because the Wf-122 P1.2 scale-guard correctly rejects the ASTSR-collapse trick that was driving the pre-fix pseudo-baseline. The post-fix R² is the TRUE R² on the Wf-49 §Cause 2 signal-floor regime.

wf122_fixes_applied: Wf-122 P1: Hilbert primal-dual Tikhonov ridge (l2_lambda=0.01 + adaptive schedule)
Wf-122 P1.2: ASTSR scale-mismatch guard in _score (rejects mode A collapse + mode B explode)
Wf-122 P1.3: best_ast_lisp() method-based accessor (replaces broken hasattr check)

wf128_p3_3way_3way_observations.description: Wf-128 P3 3-way on PlatinAI 4-cell is PASS on the verdict gate (3-way ≥ Hilbert) BUT the absolute combined R² = -114.87 is WORSE than Wf-122 P3 post-fix combined R² = -5.66. This is consistent with the Wf-128 P3 collapse detector flagging 100% of folds across all 4 cell-lines (collapse_any=YES in all 20 (cell, seed) combos). The 3-way integration inherits collapse modes from the ASTSR stream when the feature stack is 172-d zero-padded (no 32-d Multi-PH or 128-d PLL data).
wf128_p3_3way_3way_observations.verdict_vs_wf122_post_fix: WORSE (-114.87 vs -5.66; the Wf-128 P3 collapse-on-all-folds regime)
wf128_p3_3way_3way_observations.verdict_vs_hilbert_baseline: PASS (3-way = -114.87 is LESS NEGATIVE than Hilbert = -124.54; lift +9.66)
wf128_p3_3way_3way_observations.interpretation: The Wf-128 P3 3-way is a relative PASS over single-stream Hilbert (lift +9.66 R²) but a relative REGRESSION over Wf-122 P3 combined (-109.21 R² gap). The collapse flag indicates the 3-way blend is dominated by the ASTSR [0, 1] clip regime on the zero-padded PlatinAI 4-cell features. Architectural lift requires Multi-PH + PLL real features (Wf-94 R20-P3).

wf_139_p4_l7_arch_ceiling_closeout.wf_tag: Wf-139 Phase 4 — L5/L7/L10 R² architectural ceiling honest close-out
wf_139_p4_l7_arch_ceiling_closeout.l7_arch_ceiling_proof: 12-d RDKit signal |ρ| ≤ 0.019 on PlatinAI pIC50 (Wf-49 §Cause 2 audit); linear R² upper bound = (0.019)² · 12 = 0.0043. Wf-129 P3 Multi-PH+PLL (256→64 variance-rank) MEASURED R² = -0.0780; closest to zero of the 3 Wf. +5.58 R² delta over Wf-122 P3 post-fix is regularisation stabilisation (Hilbert L2 + ASTSR scale + W₂ pIC50 dist), NOT signal-floor lift. The 64-d variance-rank projection is dominated by 12-d RDKit + bond-angle histogram (target-signal |ρ| ≤ 0.019 on both).
l7_lift_paths: Wf-94 R20-P3 Multi-PH + PLL real feature augmentation on 172-d PlatinAI stack (~3 wk GPU retrain)
R23-P6 wet-lab pIC50 hybrid training (~12-18 mo)
wf_139_p4_l7_arch_ceiling_closeout.l7_paper_section6_verdict: RELEGATE to §6 honest limitations; do NOT cite in §4 main; cite the Wf-129 P3 R² = -0.0780 vs target +0.30 vs Wf-37 P3 baseline +0.087 as the architectural-ceiling evidence.
wf_139_p4_l7_arch_ceiling_closeout.wf128_p3_3way_caveat_refreshed: Wf-128 P3 3-way on PlatinAI 4-cell (combined R² = -114.87, collapse_any = 20/20) is PASS vs single-stream Hilbert (-124.54, lift +9.66) but REGRESSION vs Wf-122 P3 post-fix (-5.66, gap -109.21). The collapse-on-all-folds regime is driven by the ASTSR [0,1] clip on zero-padded 172-d features. The Wf-128 P3 lift is +9.66 R² over Hilbert, but the absolute R² is still bounded by the same 12-d signal floor — hence the same architectural-ceiling conclusion as Wf-129 P3.

honest_framing_note: All values are MEASURED on the PlatinAI 4-cell real pIC50 regression cohort (n=4078 rows × 4 cell lines). Negative R² is preserved (predictor worse than constant mean). The wf122_p3_post_fix anchor is WORSE than the pre-fix wf85_p3 anchor because the ASTSR-collapse trick (constant predictor yielding R² ≈ -0.014) that was hiding behind the pre-fix pseudo-baseline has been correctly identified and rejected by the Wf-122 P1.2 scale-guard. The post-fix -5.66 is the TRUE combined R² on the Wf-49 §Cause 2 signal-floor regime (every F5_RDKIT_2D feature has |ρ| < 0.02 on PlatinAI pIC50). Wf-139 P4 close-out (TODO/completed/137_l5_l7_l10_arch_ceiling_honest.md) confirms this is an ARCHITECTURAL CEILING: 3 independent Wf (Wf-127 / Wf-128 / Wf-129) converge on the 12-d RDKit signal floor. The architectural fix for lifting R² ≥ 0 is Multi-PH + PLL feature augmentation (Wf-66 / TODO-94 R20-P3 GPU retrain) + AlphaFold-Multimer protein-aware descriptors (R22-P4) + wet-lab pIC50 labels (R23-P6), NOT combined-blend engineering on the 12-d RDKit floor. The Wf-128 P3 3-way result (-114.87, collapse_any=20/20) is PASS vs single-stream Hilbert (-124.54, lift +9.66) but FAIL vs Wf-122 P3 post-fix combined (-5.66, regression -109.21). The Wf-129 P3 Multi-PH+PLL end-to-end guarded sibling MEASURED R² = -0.0780 (per-cell-line: MCF7 -0.0582 / A549 -0.0702 / A2780 -0.0967 / A2780cis -0.0868) — +5.58 R² delta over Wf-122 P3 post-fix; the regularisers PREVENT divergence but do NOT lift the architectural signal floor.
